definitions.gloss: grappling technique; clinch technique; locking technique
definitions.explanation: A technique in martial arts involving close-body contact such as holds, locks, throws, and pins. Used in judo, jiu-jitsu, wrestling, and other grappling arts, as opposed to striking techniques.

examples.japanese: ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{組|く}み{技|わざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{武道|ぶどう}→武道：09640_budou⟧だ。
examples.english: Judo is a martial art centered on grappling techniques.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{組|く}み{技|わざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧で、{寝技|ねわざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}む→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧。
examples.english: That athlete is skilled in grappling techniques and is good at taking fights to the ground.

examples.japanese: {総合格闘技|そうごうかくとうぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{打撃|だげき}→打撃：12775_dageki⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧{組|く}み{技|わざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: In mixed martial arts, practicing grappling techniques is indispensable alongside striking.

notes:
Composed of {組|く}み (grappling, interlocking) and ⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧ (technique). In Japanese martial arts terminology, techniques are broadly divided into {組|く}み{技|わざ} (grappling) and {打撃技|だげきわざ} (striking). Grappling includes throws (⟦{投|な}げ{技|わざ}→投げ技：17228_nagewaza⟧), joint locks (⟦{関節技|かんせつわざ}→関節技：23981_kansetsuwaza⟧), pins ({固|かた}め{技|わざ}), and chokes ({絞|し}め{技|わざ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {組|く}み{技|わざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕掛|しか}ける→仕掛ける：04243_shikakeru⟧: to initiate a grappling technique
- {組|く}み{技|わざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{攻防|こうぼう}→攻防：12925_koubou⟧: grappling exchanges
- {組|く}み{技|わざ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: strong in grappling
- {組|く}み{技|わざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧: grappling fundamentals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {寝技|ねわざ}: ground technique — grappling done specifically on the ground
- {立|た}ち{技|わざ}: standing technique — techniques performed while standing, including both strikes and throws
- ⟦{関節技|かんせつわざ}→関節技：23981_kansetsuwaza⟧: joint lock — a specific category of grappling technique targeting joints
